description: A yellow cup sits near the center-left, a gray tray with some clear ice cubes is in the middle, and a purple dustpan rests on the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup as a left-hand object, lifts and tilts it over the gray tray to dump additional ice cubes in, then rotates it upright and sets it back down; the right hand stays off to the right, hovering without touching any object.
